note: Internal-evidence locations under ax:workspace are outside this repo and read-only; external sources were fetched on the accessed date and are summarised, not copied.

sources.title: Meta Ads Safe Zones (tool page)
sources.supports: Reels 1080x1920: top 269 px (14%), bottom 672 px (35%), sides 65 px (6%), plus a lower-right button block; says measurements match Meta's downloadable overlays. Not Meta's own text.

sources.title: Independent reviewer's working notes and measurement scripts (v4)
sources.supports: ASR passes, clipped phonemes in ms, join levels, digital-zero runs, flash frames, skin dE at cuts, screen-by-screen claims audit.

sources.title: V5 addendum: independent reviewer's findings on v4, consolidated
sources.supports: Per-short blockers with timestamps; tool fixes T1-T3; how the gate must measure the rendered file.

sources.title: X/Twitter media guidelines
sources.supports: X video 0.5-140 s (longer possible for some accounts), aspect ratio 1:3 to 3:1, max 1280x1024, <= 512 MB, <= 60 fps; links X's developer media docs. API-upload oriented.

sources.title: VDI-LESSONS-001: Short-form video production lessons (AX series, Nov 22-23 2026)
sources.supports: Canonical seed: every rule with what happened, the rule and the check.

sources.title: Unlock the power of Reel ads
sources.supports: Recommends vertical 9:16 video with audio, key messages in the Reels safe zone; states over 75% of Reels views on Instagram are sound on.

sources.title: YouTube 'Stats for nerds' and loudness normalization
sources.supports: YouTube turns louder-than-reference content down and does not turn quieter content up; 'content loudness' is the difference from the reference; YouTube does not publish the reference value.

sources.title: Instagram officially expands Reels length to 3 minutes
sources.supports: Reels up to three minutes (from 90 s); Instagram's earlier guidance was not to post Reels longer than 90 s.

sources.title: Creative best practices for performance ads
sources.supports: Ads guidance: hook in the first 6 s, proposition in the first 3 s; captions/text overlays at 5-10 words per second; >= 720p; 9:16; sound/music; DIY, not over-polished style; keep content in the UI safe zone.

sources.title: TikTok Auction In-Feed Ads: video ad specifications
sources.supports: Ads only: vertical 9:16 recommended at >= 540x960; non-Spark up to 10 minutes; safe zone depends on dimension and ad caption length; <= 500 MB; >= 516 kbps.

sources.title: Understand your YouTube content performance
sources.supports: Shorts metric 'Stayed to watch' = percentage of times viewers stayed past the initial seconds; 'Engaged views' exclude loops.

sources.title: Understand three-minute YouTube Shorts
sources.supports: Shorts up to three minutes with a square or vertical aspect ratio (standard channels: uploads after 15 Oct 2024); a Short over one minute with an active copyright claim is blocked globally.
